channels.name: Open25-DM32 Classic
channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · DMR, FM and conventional P25

releases.notes: MIT firmware source, P25 CAI and fixed-point full-rate IMBE codec. Fixes silent first DMR calls from a microphone-routing timing gap; the fix was confirmed on a DM-32UV. Adds P25 startup microphone conditioning and idle amplifier gating to address clicks and hiss. Separate RX/TX NACs are included; TX defaults to Same as RX, and older Classic builds skip split-NAC channels. Includes the MIT P25 codec and preserves the radio's separate proprietary DMR codec, bootloader and radio data. Full software, sanitizer, target stack/ABI and reproducible-build checks passed. Known issues: PL/CTCSS may drop during DTMF; an intermittent P25 PTT startup failure with no RF remains under investigation. Acoustic and hardware-revision qualification is incomplete. Save a full backup before installing.

Improves repeated P25 calls, receive recovery, warning-beep audio ownership and switching between FM, DMR and P25. Preserves DCS signaling during DTMF. Known issue: PL/CTCSS signaling can drop while transmitting DTMF. Retains r6 codec compatibility. Application-only package: uses the codec read from your own radio; no codec bytes are distributed. Bootloader and radio data are preserved. Save a full backup before installing. Release candidate; microphone/speaker audio, every hardware revision and all RF conditions have not been qualified.

Adds RadioFoundry-compatible DM32 codec profiles through NRFB .050, including .046 HR and NRF/fanti .049. The firmware table memory limit matches current RadioFoundry. Application-only package: prepares or preserves the codec read from your own radio; no codec bytes are distributed. Bootloader and radio data are preserved. Earlier releases remain available but cannot use the wider .050 codec tables. Save a full backup before installing. Release candidate; final on-air qualification remains incomplete.

Fixes Start new when another firmware’s settings prevent saving a new codeplug. Success is shown only after creation and the requested edit are saved. Release candidate: RadioFoundry UI with DMR, FM and conventional P25. Application-only package; uses the codec already on your radio. First installation supports OEM .048, .049 and NRF .049; later updates preserve the prepared codec. Bootloader and radio data are preserved during flashing. Save a full backup before installing. Final on-air qualification remains incomplete.
